verses.gurmukhi: ੫ : ਮੀਣੇ ਦੀ ਸੰਗਤ ਖੋਟੀ ਤੇ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 5 : meene dhee sa(n)gat khoTee te dhukhadhaiee hai

en.bdb: Association with the dissembler is bad as well as painful

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੈਹਾ ਦਿਸੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਮਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਿਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaihaa dhisai ujalaa mas a(n)dhar chitai|

en.bdb: The bronze appears bright but inside it remains blackness .

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਆ ਤਿਲੁ ਬੂਆੜ ਜਿਉ ਫਲੁ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: hariaa til booaaR jiau fal ka(n)m na kitai|

en.bdb: Baal: weed plant in a field of sesame may be lush green but it. fruit is worthless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਕਲੀ ਕਨੇਰ ਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਹੁ ਭਿਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: jehee kalee kaner dhee man tan dhuh bhitai|

en.bdb: The oleander bud has two aspects; externally it is beautiful but internally it is poisonous.
Pelijha, the ripe fruit of wild caper looks colourful but over eating it man dies instantly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਰੀ ਸੁਆਲਿਓ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਜੀਅ ਬਝਾ ਇਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: kharee suaalio vesuaa jeea bajhaa itai|

en.bdb: Prostitute looks very beautiful but she ensnares the mind (and ultimately man stands finished).

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੀਣਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਂਦੀ ਮਿਤੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: khoTee sa(n)gat meeniaa dhukh dhe(n)dhee mitai ||5||

en.bdb: Similarly, dissembler's company causes suffering for their friends
